## Activity

During December 2021, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 360 captures as part of its routine screening activity. This represents the total number of image sets submitted for review during the month. The activity level provides the basis for monitoring the service’s workflow and assessing the timeliness and quality of subsequent grading.

## Image quality

Of the images submitted, 10 sets were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.8 per cent of all captures. The clinic should continue to monitor image acquisition and record recurring camera issues with the service desk, so that equipment-related problems can be identified and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

A total of 62 results were graded referable during December 2021. These results require the relevant follow-up arrangements under the service pathway. The median grading wait was 18 days, providing an indicator of the time between image submission and completion of grading. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues continue to be logged with the service desk. This will support local review of image quality and help maintain a clear record of operational issues affecting capture or grading.
